label: UNITING-CAUSE_3, from perfection
meaning: Strength order within UNITING-CAUSE_3 / BECOMING-BEING-CAUSE_3: nothing causes a perfection in itself implies nothing causes its own being (r = esse). The strong version is conditionally refuted (SELF-PERFECTING-SUBJECT-REFUTES-NO-SELF-PERFECTION); the weak version survives that refutation.
